svg.aria-label: Simulation diagnostics. In A, each bar represents an independent sample after combining three technical wells. Each target-to-reference ratio is divided by the geometric mean of the three control-sample ratios, giving a control geometric mean of 1 and an arithmetic mean of about 1.003. B shows simulated melting curves; C shows the theoretical probability of an empty well; D compares efficiency effects when the true starting amount is fourfold higher.
